Measurement and units: Mg, MgO or MgCl2 assay (wt%, stated basis); impurities (ppm or wt%); reagents (kg/kg accepted Mg)
Proposed evidence requirement — analysis: Run real, variable feed; record raw and prepared-feed assays, rejects and purchased intermediates.
Why it matters / evidence context: Pure-feed experiments do not establish treatment of a commercial brine or ore.

Measurement and units: Mg recovery (% of Mg in feed); electricity (kWh/kg accepted Mg); direct heat (MJ/kg)
Proposed evidence requirement — analysis: Close the mass balance through refining and casting; separate current efficiency from saleable-metal recovery.
Why it matters / evidence context: A good cell result can coexist with costly preparation or finishing losses.

Measurement and units: Component life (h); plant availability (%); maintenance downtime (h)
Proposed evidence requirement — analysis: Demonstrate continuous operation, planned shutdowns and restart; disclose component replacement and yield loss.
Why it matters / evidence context: Research campaign length and design capacity do not establish annual output.

Measurement and units: Element limits (wt% or ppm); rejected lots (%); buyer trial results
Proposed evidence requirement — analysis: Meet the full agreed chemistry and product-form specification over repeated lots; verify the intended application.
Why it matters / evidence context: Overall Mg purity does not capture every corrosion-critical impurity or casting requirement.

Measurement and units: Emissions (kg CO2e/kg accepted Mg); water (m3/t); residues (kg/t)
Proposed evidence requirement — analysis: Use an explicit feed-to-metal boundary and identified electricity supply; establish permitted waste and coproduct handling.
Why it matters / evidence context: A cell-only inventory cannot establish whole-chain environmental performance.

Measurement and units: Delivered cost ($/kg); qualified purchases (t/y); feed and power commitments (years)
Proposed evidence requirement — analysis: Separate binding commitments from interest and targets; validate financing, supply contracts and customer acceptance.
Why it matters / evidence context: Future distribution targets demonstrate a market channel, not realized operating revenue.
